name: singlet_foundation_models_zero_shot_cell_embedding
title: Zero-shot cell embedding and cell-type separation
description: Embeds a raw-count dataset with a frozen foundation model (scgpt or uce) or a baseline (hvg_pca or scvi), then scores expert cell-type separation with ARI, NMI, cell-type ASW and cLISI. The default is the hvg_pca baseline, so choose a foundation model explicitly. Writes an embedding, cluster labels and a score table. Do not use it to annotate cells, to fine-tune a model, or to judge a model on studies in its pretraining corpus.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Embedding method. hvg_pca is the baseline and default; scgpt and uce are frozen; scvi trains on the dataset.

scoring.description: Label, neighbourhood and resolution settings for the separation scores; applies to every method.

labels_key.description: obs column of expert labels; used for scoring only, never as an input.

batch_key.description: Optional obs column for stratified reporting; null for none.

embedding_metric.description: Distance for silhouette and cLISI; cosine is a sensitivity check.

n_neighbors.description: Neighbours in the kNN graph used for Leiden clustering.

resolution.description: Fixed Leiden resolution; null optimises ARI over ten values in [0, 2].

pretraining_accessions.description: Study accessions in the method's pretraining corpus; matching studies are flagged.

scgpt.description: Options for method scgpt; rejected for other methods.

model_dir.description: Directory of the frozen scGPT checkpoint; required for method scgpt.

gene_col.description: var column matching the scGPT gene vocabulary.

uce.description: Options for method uce; rejected for other methods.

model_dir.description: Directory of the frozen UCE model files; required for method uce.

species.description: Species of the input; the OpenProblems wrapper accepts only human and mouse.

nlayers.description: Pretrained model depth; 4-layer and 33-layer embeddings are not interchangeable.

batch_size.description: Per-GPU batch size; 25 suits the 33-layer model on an 80 GB GPU.

hvg_pca.description: Options for method hvg_pca; rejected for other methods.

n_top_genes.description: Highly variable genes kept, selected by the seurat_v3 flavour on raw counts.

n_comps.description: Principal components retained for the baseline embedding.

scvi.description: Options for method scvi; rejected for other methods.

n_latent.description: Latent dimensionality of the scVI embedding.

gene_likelihood.description: Count likelihood of the scVI decoder.

max_epochs.description: Training epochs; null uses the library rule.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for Leiden clustering and scVI initialisation.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obsm/X_zero_shot. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs. Keys: method, n_cells, resolution, ari, nmi, cell_type_asw, clisi, leakage_flag. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
